tidy3d_straight_port_comparison.scope: Bound fundamental Ez index of each straight elbow lead. Full polygon scattering is independently checked with a frequency-domain Helmholtz solve.

source_arrays_scope: All native modal projections, indices and early/late complex matrices on all seven runs; one full final-time nominal device Ez plane. Prefix-free keys describe the default 32-cell elbow.

field_preview.description: Final-time Ez from the west-port launch on the 32-cell/µm elbow after the source and 100 µm/c of observation.
